'''Pikkson''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Kynachi (species)|Kynachi]], who was a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] for [[KynachTech Industries]]. In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], he and [[Sunmantle]] were assigned to escort [[Commissioner (Kynachi)|Commissioner]] [[Langu Sommilor]] to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Sommilor and the two pilots were replaced by [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] impostors, who were later [[Mission to Vaced|assassinated]]. The real Pikkson was soon discovered with the others onboard their [[TL-1800 transport|TL-1800 freighter]], and completed the voyage to Coruscant with [[Breakout Squad]] and the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Nuru Kungurama]].

==Biography==
Pikkson was a [[Kynachi (species)|Kynachi]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] for [[KynachTech Industries]].<ref name="SM4" /> In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="Annual">''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]'' places the [[Battle of the Kaliida Nebula/Legends|Battle of the Kaliida Nebula]] in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]]. The battle takes place just prior to the ''Secret Missions'' series.</ref> along with the pilot [[Sunmantle]], he was assigned to escort [[Commissioner (Kynachi)|Commissioner]] [[Langu Sommilor|Sommilor]] to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Pikkson and the others were accosted at the landing pad and replaced by [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] imposters.<ref name="SM4" /> The imposters [[Mission to Vaced|arrived]] on [[Vaced/Legends|Vaced]] to meet with their escort, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Nuru Kungurama]] and were [[Death/Legends|killed]] by a [[Sniper/Legends|sniper]].<ref name="SM3">''[[The Clone Wars: Secret Missions 3: Duel at Shattered Rock]]''</ref> In the aftermath of the [[Battle of Bilbringi Depot|battle]] at [[Bilbringi Depot]], the real Pikkson, Sunmantle, and Sommilor were discovered tied up in their [[TL-1800 transport|TL-1800 freighter's]] hold. Pikkson and Sunmantle then piloted the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] to Coruscant, landing at the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]]. While Sommilor was led to a meeting with [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], the two KynacTech pilots took Kungurama and his [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Breakout Squad]] to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]]. En route, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Harro Kelpura]] received notification that his research lab in the [[Dacho District]] had been broken into, and ordered a change of course. Once there, the freighter was impacted by a [[Sleight of Hand|dropship]] belonging to a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] assisting in the break-in. The ship was damaged and crashed. Kungurama ordered Pikkson to take off, but the landing gear had been snagged. Kungurama cleared it and they took off again, but upon approaching the lab, they were hit by a [[Missile/Legends|missile]], causing Breakout Squad to fall out. Pikkson and Sunmantle then piloted the freighter out of sight.<ref name="SM4" />

==Behind the scenes==
"Pikkson" first appeared in [[Ryder Windham]]'s young readers book, ''[[The Clone Wars: Secret Missions 3: Duel at Shattered Rock]]'', but was revealed to be an impostor in the following book, ''[[The Clone Wars: Secret Missions 4: Guardians of the Chiss Key]]''. The real Pikkson joined with Breakout Squad for the voyage to Coruscant.
